# Calibration report (regenerated by `python -m incognita.uq.calibration_report`)

Coverage = share of points whose |pred - y| is within the interval half-width. CIs: percentile bootstrap over nuclide_ids
(2000 replicates, fixed seed). ECE = mean |observed - nominal| coverage of central intervals 5-95 %, percentage points
(0 = perfect; it and the PIT histogram assume a Student-t through the 68 and 95 % half-widths; the coverages do not).
Sharpness = rms error in the widest quarter of intervals / rms error in the narrowest quarter (1 = the width does not rank
the errors; target >= 1.5). Strata with fewer than 20 rows are not scored.
